claims.claim: The dedicated harness fixes the provider to antigravity, the model to gemini-3.8-flash, and explicit effort to high. The committed delta changes no provider or default policy files.

The harness builds a deterministic, self-contained synthetic PRIMARY request with production composers and validators. One JsonReviewerProvider uses one recording wrapper around one GeminiReviewerTransport; the wrapper binds the exact delivered bytes to the request fingerprint and SHA-256.

The closed observation contract is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Validated decisions include one-call attribution, request and decision fingerprints, and native token usage without copying the semantic verdict.

One-call typed provider failures produce bounded exit-0 PROVIDER_FAILURE observations. Invalid proof input, request identity or call count, observation defects, and unexpected runner exceptions produce nonzero integrity failure without a normal observation.
The harness has no direct imports of the forbidden authority modules and contains no REVIEW submission, lifecycle mutation, credential inspection, retry, fallback, or downstream action.

Offline focused tests use injected native runners to cover deterministic construction, exact CLI admission, valid verdicts, one-call delivery, provider and integrity failures, leakage, and observation bounds. The committed delta contains only the two authorized files.
